categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Modifies `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h`, `bitcoinkernel.cpp`, and `bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h` to change the public libbitcoinkernel C API logging interface.
categories.rationale: Making `btck_LogEntry` opaque aligns it with other kernel types and avoids fixing struct layout in the ABI. As the author notes, this 'allows adding or changing fields without breaking the ABI, and is consistent with ~all other kernel objects.' While it improves library ABI extensibility, the work is an internal C API refinement and reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label, the PR touches only `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.*` C API files and alters no validation rules, chainstate handling, or consensus logic.
categories.rationale: Validation explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API. This PR changes only the public C API logging types and getters without affecting validation behavior.
